f3_program: collection("monica.cookies", "cookie", "monica.family", source("Monica made cookies for herself and her family"))
produce("make_cookies", "monica", at("monica.cookies.count", "current"), 30, source("she made 30 cookies in total"))
consume("father_eats_cookies", "monica.father", at("monica.cookies.count", "current"), 10, source("Her father ate 10 cookies"))

consume("mother_eats_cookies", "monica.mother", at("monica.cookies.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("father_eats_cookies", "quantity"), 1, 2), source("her mother ate half as much as the father"))
consume("brother_eats_cookies", "monica.brother", at("monica.cookies.count", "current"), "monica.brother.cookies_eaten.count", source("Her brother ate 2 more than her mother"))
offset(event_field("brother_eats_cookies", "quantity"), event_field("mother_eats_cookies", "quantity"), 2, "count", source("Her brother ate 2 more than her mother"))
query("remaining_count", "monica.cookies", "current")
observe(at("jason.car.cost", "current"), 32000, "dollar", source("The car he wants costs $32,000"))
observe(at("jason.car.down_payment", "current"), 8000, "dollar", source("he can make a down payment of $8,000"))
difference_relation(at("jason.car.loan.principal", "current"), at("jason.car.cost", "current"), at("jason.car.down_payment", "current"), source("loan for the rest of the amount"))
observe(at("jason.car.loan.payment_count", "current"), 48, "count", source("make 48 equal monthly payments on it"))

quotient_relation(at("jason.car.loan.base_monthly_payment", "current"), at("jason.car.loan.principal", "current"), at("jason.car.loan.payment_count", "current"), source("make 48 equal monthly payments on it"))
percent_of(at("jason.car.loan.monthly_interest", "current"), at("jason.car.loan.base_monthly_payment", "current"), 5, source("interest equal to 5% of that month's payment"))

sum_relation(at("jason.car.loan.monthly_payment", "current"), at("jason.car.loan.base_monthly_payment", "current"), at("jason.car.loan.monthly_interest", "current"), source("Each month, he also has to pay interest equal to 5% of that month's payment"))
query("value", at("jason.car.loan.monthly_payment", "current"))
assumptions: "that month's payment" refers to the equal loan installment before the separately stated interest.

f3_program: collection("jenna.friends", "friend", "concert_group", source("her group of five friends"))
observe(at("jenna.friends.count", "current"), 5, "count", source("five friends"))
collection("jenna.friends.ticket_payments", "payment", "concert", source("Jenna is buying concert tickets for her group of five friends"))
observe(at("jenna.website_ticket_purchase.ticket_count", "current"), 2, "count", source("two of the tickets from the concert website"))
observe(at("concert.ticket.normal_price", "current"), 50, "dollar_per_ticket", source("$50 each"))

product_relation(at("jenna.website_ticket_purchase.total_payment", "current"), at("jenna.website_ticket_purchase.ticket_count", "current"), at("concert.ticket.normal_price", "current"), source("two of the tickets from the concert website for $50 each"))
member("jenna.friends.ticket_payments", "jenna.website_ticket_purchase.total_payment", source("two of the tickets from the concert website for $50 each"))
observe(at("jenna.scalper_ticket_purchase.ticket_count", "current"), 2, "count", source("two more tickets"))
percent_of(at("jenna.scalper_ticket_purchase.unit_price", "current"), at("concert.ticket.normal_price", "current"), 240, source("240% of the normal price"))

product_relation(at("jenna.scalper_ticket_purchase.total_before_discount", "current"), at("jenna.scalper_ticket_purchase.ticket_count", "current"), at("jenna.scalper_ticket_purchase.unit_price", "current"), source("two more tickets for 240% of the normal price"))
offset(at("jenna.scalper_ticket_purchase.total_payment", "current"), at("jenna.scalper_ticket_purchase.total_before_discount", "current"), -10, "dollar", source("$10 off that total payment"))
member("jenna.friends.ticket_payments", "jenna.scalper_ticket_purchase.total_payment", source("give her $10 off that total payment"))
observe(at("jenna.job_ticket_purchase.ticket_count", "current"), 1, "count", source("one of her friends gets a discounted ticket"))
percent_of(at("jenna.job_ticket_purchase.unit_price", "current"), at("concert.ticket.normal_price", "current"), 60, source("60% of the normal price"))

product_relation(at("jenna.job_ticket_purchase.total_payment", "current"), at("jenna.job_ticket_purchase.ticket_count", "current"), at("jenna.job_ticket_purchase.unit_price", "current"), source("a discounted ticket through her job for 60% of the normal price"))
member("jenna.friends.ticket_payments", "jenna.job_ticket_purchase.total_payment", source("a discounted ticket through her job for 60% of the normal price"))
query("sum", "jenna.friends.ticket_payments", "current")
assumptions: The $50 website price is the normal ticket price referenced later.
The 240% scalper price applies to each of the two tickets before the $10 transaction-level discount.
